we propose a new way of evaluating the quality of neural embeddings for the link prediction task on knowledge graphs.
we provide a unified evaluation methodology for the link prediction task, and with this, we aim to provide a common ground for the comparison of different methodologies and datasets.
we propose a novel way to evaluate the link prediction tasks with neural embeddings, which is more comprehensive, and more transparent.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the task of link prediction with neural embeddings, global training outperforms local training.
global training of neural embeddings is a viable alternative for local training of neural embeddings, and it is more robust to noise in the data.
the global evaluation of the embeddings is more informative than local evaluations, and the global evaluation can also be used to compare embeddings from different sources.
